spine: 1. Mindgard 發現 Cursor 在 Windows 上開專案時，若 repo 根目錄放了假的 git.exe，會無提示、無對話框直接執行它。
2. PoC 顯示這不是一次性執行：只要專案保持開啟，Cursor 會反覆重新執行那個假的 git.exe，計算機視窗隨時間累積出現。
3. Mindgard 依 security.txt 走正規 email 回報流程，三天後追蹤仍無下文。
4. 換到 LinkedIn 公開求助後才輾轉聯繫上 CISO，CISO 坦承自動化流程失效、手動邀入 HackerOne，但報告先被判 Informative and out of scope。
5. Mindgard 申覆後，HackerOne 重新開啟報告並自行重現問題，確認細節已轉交 Cursor——存在與可重現不再是爭議點。
6. 2 月到 4 月間 Mindgard 多次透過 email、HackerOne、CISO 本人追問，幾乎都沒有實質回應。
7. 6 月起 Mindgard 通知即將公開，7 月 14 日發布全面揭露文章，並附上個人與企業的暫時緩解建議；截至發文，漏洞仍未修正。

perspective.mechanism: Cursor 在 Windows 上載入專案時會在多個位置搜尋 git 執行檔，workspace 根目錄是其中一個候選位置；若根目錄放了偽造的 git.exe，Cursor 會無提示直接執行它，且只要專案保持開啟就會反覆重新執行。
perspective.tradeoff: 協調揭露仰賴廠商在合理時間內回應與修補；當 email、HackerOne 平台、CISO 本人三個管道都在半年內無法產出實質進展，繼續等待對已暴露風險的使用者不公平，全面公開便成為研究者僅剩的選項——但公開同時也把攻擊細節攤在所有潛在攻擊者面前。
perspective.reader_use: 在 Windows 上用 Cursor（或類似 AI 編輯器）開啟外部/第三方 repo 的團隊，這週就能檢查是否部署 AppLocker／Windows App Control 路徑規則、開新 repo 前是否先看過根目錄可疑執行檔；漏洞修正前，不熟悉的 repo 應只在隔離 VM 或 Windows Sandbox 中開啟。

perspective.mechanism: 忠實摘要 Mindgard 原文機制——repo 內若有 git.exe，Cursor 在 Windows 下會執行到它而非系統安裝的 git，直接升級成 ACE；並引用原文英文段落佐證。
perspective.tradeoff: gslin 的評論點出：漏洞本身或許難免，但整個回報流程（email→CISO→HackerOne）三個管道都失效，這件事本身比漏洞更嚴重，是對外部讀者的一次獨立判斷與轉述，而非新增事實。
perspective.reader_use: 對中文技術圈讀者來說，這篇轉載往往是第一次接觸原始英文報告的管道，也提供了在地工程師「這件事有多嚴重」的第一手參考意見。

notes.quote: When loading a project, Cursor attempts to locate Git binaries across multiple locations. One of those locations includes the workspace itself.
notes.interpretation: Cursor 在載入專案時的 git 執行檔搜尋邏輯包含 workspace 根目錄本身；文章未列出完整搜尋順序或位置間的優先次序。

notes.quote: This bug is simple. A developer opens a repository in Cursor on Windows, and if that repository contains a malicious git.exe in the project root, Cursor will execute it automatically. There are no clicks, prompts, approval dialogs, or warnings. The result is arbitrary code execution.
notes.interpretation: 核心漏洞描述：repo 根目錄的惡意 git.exe 會被 Cursor 無提示自動執行，結果是任意程式碼執行。

notes.quote: the multiple Calculator windows were not opened manually by the researcher. Cursor continued to re-execute the renamed binary while the project was left open, causing more instances to appear over time.
notes.interpretation: PoC 證實只要專案保持開啟，惡意執行檔會被反覆重新執行，不是單次觸發；未給出具體時間間隔。

notes.quote: last verified on April 30, 2026 against Cursor version 3.2.16 on Windows
notes.interpretation: 這是報告最後一次驗證的時間與版本快照，不是受影響版本範圍的宣告；文中未指明漏洞起始版本或是否已在其他分支修正。

notes.quote: Dec 15, 2025 Vulnerability discovered by Mindgard / Vulnerability reported to security-reports@cursor.com; Dec 18, 2025 Follow-up requesting confirmation of receipt; Jan 13, 2026 Mindgard created a LinkedIn post requesting a contact at Cursor to assist. Cursor CISO is mentioned by a user in the comments.; Jan 15, 2026 Cursor CISO responds to the e-mail thread indicating an automation failed that was supposed to invite to the HackerOne private bounty program. CISO manually invites Mindgard to the bounty program. / Vulnerability submitted through HackerOne; Jan 16, 2026 Report initially closed as Informative and out of scope / Mindgard challenges determination / Report reopened after successful reproduction; Jan 20, 2026 HackerOne confirms delivery to Cursor; Feb 16, 2026 Update requested, no response received; Mar 3, 2026 Update requested, no response received; Mar 17, 2026 Direct outreach to Cursor CISO requesting update; Mar 18, 2026 HackerOne indicates Cursor has been contacted; Apr 1, 2026 Update requested, no response received / HackerOne confirms no update from Cursor; Jun 1, 2026 Mindgard informs HackerOne of intent to disclose publicly; Jun 3, 2026 HackerOne provides disclosure guidance; Jul 14 2026 This blog post published.
notes.interpretation: 完整的揭露時間線表格，逐一核對過兩次獨立 WebFetch 抓取結果一致；用於文中 H2「半年、三個管道、一次次石沉大海」的時間線 widget 與敘事。

notes.quote: The report was initially closed as Informative and out of scope.
notes.interpretation: HackerOne 上的回報最初被歸類為僅供參考、不在處理範圍。

notes.quote: After we challenged that determination, HackerOne reopened the report, reproduced the issue, and confirmed that the details had been delivered to Cursor.
notes.interpretation: Mindgard 申覆後，HackerOne 自行重現問題並確認已轉交 Cursor，漏洞存在與可重現性不再是爭議點。

notes.quote: Like many security research teams, Mindgard prefers coordinated disclosure.
notes.interpretation: Mindgard 表態自身偏好協調揭露而非直接公開。

notes.quote: Full disclosure is the nuclear option of vulnerability disclosure, reserved for situations where every other path has failed.
notes.interpretation: 全面揭露被 Mindgard 定位為最後手段，只在其他管道都失敗時使用。

notes.quote: Trust requires accountability, and accountability requires communication. When users, researchers, and disclosure platforms spend months seeking basic status updates without success, that accountability becomes difficult to see or believe in.
notes.interpretation: 文章收尾論點：信任建立在可問責之上，而可問責建立在溝通之上；長期要不到基本狀態更新會侵蝕這份信任。

notes.quote: Given that Cursor is one of the most widely adopted AI-assisted development environments (7 million+ active users, 1 million+ daily, 1 million+ paying, used by 50K+ companies), and its reported market price of $60 billion, it's fair to assume that some level of respect for security practices exists, but this issue would indicate otherwise.
notes.interpretation: Mindgard 自己的用戶規模與市值描述，並以反諷語氣指出這個案例顯示的資安應對與規模不相稱；引用時保留原文的反諷框架，不把它改寫成單純的斷言。

notes.quote: As a temporary mitigation on managed Windows systems, administrators can use AppLocker or Windows App Control policies to deny execution of the affected executable name from developer workspace directories. Prefer path-based deny rules scoped to repo/workspace roots, such as %USERPROFILE%\source\repos\*\filename.exe, rather than hash-based rules, because attacker-supplied binaries can vary by hash. Windows does not provide a general built-in rule to block an arbitrary child executable only when launched by a specific parent process, so parent-aware enforcement generally requires EDR or a custom endpoint security product.
notes.interpretation: 企業/受管理 Windows 環境的暫時緩解建議：路徑規則優於雜湊規則；父行程感知需要 EDR 或客製化端點防護，Windows 本身無此內建功能。

notes.quote: Until the IDE is patched, open untrusted repositories only in an isolated VM, Windows Sandbox, or other disposable environment.
notes.interpretation: 個人開發者的暫時緩解建議：修補前不熟悉的 repo 只在隔離環境開啟。

notes.quote: Initial disclosure was sent directly to Cursor's security reporting e-mail address, as specified in the company's published security.txt file.
notes.interpretation: 首次回報管道：依 Cursor 公開的 security.txt 指定信箱送出。

notes.quote: Cursor 0day: When Full Disclosure Becomes the Only Protection Left / The vulnerability nobody seems interested in fixing
notes.interpretation: 文章標題與副標，用於解釋「全面揭露是唯一保護」的字面含義。

notes.quote: Trust requires accountability, and accountability requires communication.
notes.interpretation: 同 n10 的收尾論點前半句，作為信任/可問責/溝通三者關係的核心句。

notes.quote: Cursor 在開啟 git repository 後會透過 git 指令去分析一些資料，而如果在 Windows 下，repository 內有個 git.exe 就會執行到這個檔案，而非系統安裝的 git，於是就直接升級成 ACE
notes.interpretation: gslin 對 Mindgard 機制的中文摘要，與 n01/n02 一致，屬同源摘述（echo），不是獨立技術驗證。

notes.quote: 以現在軟體的複雜度來說，有洞在所難免 (即使是很蠢的洞)，但整個回報的流程失效就很大條了...
notes.interpretation: gslin 本人的評論，明確是他自己的觀點而非轉述 Mindgard；用於呈現在地工程師的直覺反應。

notes.quote: 從時間線可以看到 Cursor 要求 Mindgard 在一開始的 e-mail 回報管道被無視 (被推託說是自動化程序失效)，後續被 CISO 要求到 HackerOne 上面回報，結果 Cursor 的人在看過回報後先是說 Informative and out of scope，然後經過 Mindgard 再次挑戰後，被 HackerOne 認定漏洞存在、可重製，然後甚至透過 HackerOne 再去跟 Cursor 接觸也被無視，於是最後公開。
notes.interpretation: gslin 對整條時間線的中文濃縮摘要，與 Mindgard 原文時間線（n05/n06/n07）內容一致，屬同源摘述。

notes.quote: 資安團隊 Mindgard 發現漏洞後被 Cursor 無視了半年，發出 public full disclosure 了
notes.interpretation: gslin 的開場摘要句，以「半年」概括整個時間跨度（實際日期範圍 2025-12-15 至 2026-07-14，約略相符）；文中用作對半年跨度的佐證性引用，不作為精確數字來源。
